# `kevin setup`

Starts the `setup` steps in dependency order, and leaves them running after it exits. Use `setup` for something that many `kevin run`s share, such as a kind cluster. Remove the steps with [`kevin teardown`]({{< relref "/docs/reference/commands/teardown" >}}).

```sh
kevin setup
kevin setup --open
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|:-----|:----:|:-------:|:------------|
| `--open` | `bool` | `false` | open the console in the default browser once it's listening |

See [Environment file]({{< relref "/docs/reference/environment-file" >}}).
